visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair, wearing a gray zip-up jacket and a backpack, stands outdoors at night. He holds a blue and white badminton racket and bites the top of the frame while looking intensely at the camera. The camera zooms in closely on his face before a sudden jump cut shows him doubled over with laughter. (2) The scene shifts to the same parking lot environment where the man is talking to friends. He gestures with his hands while white and yellow captions appear at the top and bottom. He repeats the action of biting the racket frame to demonstrate a pose. Another young man in a white t-shirt watches and reacts with a smile. (3) Multiple young men take turns posing with the badminton racket in their mouths. One wears a black hoodie with a sun and smiley face patch, while another wears a brown and white tracksuit. The man in the tracksuit attempts to drink from a plastic water bottle while holding the racket in his mouth. The lighting is provided by overhead street lamps and car headlights in the background. The video ends with a close-up of a man biting the racket and flashing a peace sign.
